description: This file defines the 'campaign_charts' class, which provides methods to generate various campaign-related charts and reports within SuiteCRM, including response analysis and ROI calculations. It interacts with chart factory classes, database queries, and chart rendering components.

classes.name: campaign_charts
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate campaign response and ROI charts in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: campaign_response_by_activity_type
methods.description: Generates a chart visualizing campaign response by activity type, with caching and dynamic data retrieval.

methods.name: campaign_response_roi
methods.description: Calculates and displays the campaign's return-on-investment chart based on campaign financial data.

methods.name: campaign_response_roi_data
methods.description: Fetches the data used for ROI charts, suitable for API or further processing.
